2609.15292.title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
2609.15292.paper_summary: Automatic Item Generation (AIG) is pivotal for personalized education, yet guaranteeing the pedagogical value of generated items remains a bottleneck. Existing Item Quality Assessment (IQA) methods typically rely on unscalable manual reviews or shallow stem-based metrics, failing to capture the reasoning process required for mathematical problem-solving. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes Process-based Item Quality Assessment (ProIQA), a process-aware framework for fine-grained quality assessment of math items. We first formulate IQA across three heterogeneous dimensions, including knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies, under a unified process-aware perspective. Based on this formulation, we construct a process-enhanced IQA resource by augmenting original item data with structured reasoning trees derived from raw solutions. Technically, ProIQA leverages Large Language Modelsto construct hierarchical reasoning trees and employs Graph Neural Networks (GNN) to encode their topological dependencies and procedural semantics. The resulting solving representation is fused with stem semantics through a dual-view (``Stem + Solving'') architecture, enabling comprehensive assessment across learning objectives. Extensive experiments on K12 mathematical datasets show that ProIQA effectively captures process-oriented features, offering a scalable data-driven solution for evaluating AIG outputs in intelligent education systems.
2609.15292.paper_summary_zh: 自動題目生成（AIG）對於個性化教育至關重要，但保證生成題目的教學價值仍然是一個瓶頸。現有的題目質量評估（IQA）方法通常依賴於不可擴展的手動審查或淺層的題幹基準指標，未能捕捉到數學問題解決所需的推理過程。為了彌補這一差距，本文提出了基於過程的題目質量評估（ProIQA），這是一個針對數學題目進行細緻質量評估的過程感知框架。我們首先從統一的過程感知視角出發，將IQA在知識概念、難度和學科能力三個異質維度上進行公式化。基於這一公式化，我們通過將原始題目數據與從原始解答中派生的結構化推理樹進行增強，構建了一個過程增強的IQA資源。在技術上，ProIQA利用大型語言模型構建分層推理樹，並採用圖神經網絡（GNN）來編碼其拓撲依賴性和過程語義。最終的解題表示通過雙視角（``題幹 + 解題''）架構與題幹語義融合，實現了對學習目標的全面評估。在K12數學數據集上進行的廣泛實驗表明，ProIQA有效捕捉了以過程為導向的特徵，為智能教育系統中評估AIG輸出提供了一個可擴展的數據驅動解決方案。
